# Canonical one-line observation of a reboot/halt/poweroff invocation (pane 214).
# Usage: observe.py LABEL STATUS LOG OUT ERR [NEEDLE]
# LOG is the system-seccomp.py JSON-lines record (or "-" when calls were not
# recorded). Values are printed, never judged, so the fixture's expected stdout
# carries the independent expectation: reboot(2) magic numbers and RB_* commands
# from <sys/reboot.h>/<linux/reboot.h>, strerror text from the C library.
# The raw streams and every recorded call are appended to observations.txt.
import json, os, pathlib, re, sys

label, status, log, out, err = sys.argv[1:6]
needle = sys.argv[6] if len(sys.argv) > 6 else None
calls, accounting, execs = [], 0, 0
if log != '-':
    for line in pathlib.Path(log).read_text().splitlines():
        record = json.loads(line)
        name = record['syscall']
        if name in ('sync', 'syncfs'):
            calls.append(name)
        elif name == 'reboot':
            calls.append('reboot(%08x,%08x,%08x)' % (record['arg0'], record['arg1'], record['arg2']))
        elif name in ('openat', 'open', 'creat', 'openat2'):
            path = str(record.get('string1', record.get('string0', '')))
            if re.search(r'utmp|wtmp|btmp|lastlog', path):
                accounting += 1
        elif name in ('execve', 'execveat'):
            execs += 1
stdout = pathlib.Path(out).read_text(errors='replace')
stderr = pathlib.Path(err).read_bytes()
if not stderr:
    error = 'empty'
elif needle is not None and needle in stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace'):
    error = 'has:' + needle
else:
    error = repr(stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
line = '%s status=%s calls=[%s] stdout=%r stderr=%s' % (label, status, ','.join(calls), stdout, error)
with open('observations.txt', 'a') as raw:
    raw.write('[%s] status %s\nstdout %r\nstderr %r\n' % (label, status, stdout, stderr))
    if log != '-':
        raw.write(pathlib.Path(log).read_text())
if log != '-' and os.environ.get('OBSERVE_EXEC') == '1':
    line += ' accounting-opens=%d execs=%d' % (accounting, execs)
print(line)
